text:
Hong Kong: about 2.2 lakh people live in rooms smaller than a parking space.

The typical subdivided room is about 110 sq ft. A parking space there is 135. Rent: about ₹55,000 a month.

The twist: only about 7% of Hong Kong's land has homes on it, and Delhi packs in more people per sq km. Since March 2026 a new law says a rented room must be at least 86 sq ft, with a window.

Would you live in one?
